$comment: Fixed inputs for docs/scenarios.html. The page runs tools/evaluate.py on each and renders the result: every decision line with its citation, every withheld line with the rule it waits on, and what the engine refuses by name. Inputs are fixed so the page is a build output like every other; it is a demonstration of cited computation against encoded rules, not a calculator and not an entitlement determination. ACTION-REGISTER 5.6.

scenarios.title: A birth, no leave taken yet
scenarios.narrative: A qualifying birth on 1 March 2027. Evaluated on 1 June 2027 with no parental leave used.

scenarios.title: Seventy days used, a five-day block proposed
scenarios.narrative: The same birth. Seventy days already used and a further five-day increment proposed on 1 June 2027.

scenarios.title: Two qualifying events a day apart
scenarios.narrative: Two qualifying events, 1 and 2 March 2027. Whether they count as one event turns on the merge window.
